impacts.reason: The intent that rebaseOraclePack must preserve lockMode directly concerns the asserted post-execution lockMode being '00'.
The preservation intent directly applies to the asserted corruption of lockMode.
The intent that rebaseOraclePack must not reset lockMode directly concerns the unintentional clearing.
The Guardian-only unlock intent directly concerns rebaseOraclePack doing unlockPool's work, and the stated precondition is that the Guardian set lockMode to 3 to prevent attack.
